Several point and click adventure games from GoG. I have a lot of fun playing them, but they aren't really accessible for people who want more modern games and often they end up being a pain in the ass or requiring a walk though depending on how long you want to spend playing them. It can sometimes be an exercise in masochism playing them. I've played a ton of them because they are cheap and I enjoy the novelty of getting to play a lot of older games I wanted to play as a kid and never really got a chance to. Also since I am a little older I still get some of the references and jokes that wouldn't really be relevant today.

If I wanted to recommend one in particular I would say play "I Have No Mouth and I Must Scream". I'd recommend a walk-through to at least reference if you get lost and don't worry too much about getting a perfect game.
